_comment: Machine-readable index of QUSX v1 normative rules. Human-readable normative source: docs/conformance/NORMATIVE-RULES.md. This file is the contract cited by the fixture manifest (test/conformance/manifest.json), the Schematron schema (schema/qusx.sch), and src/validate.js error messages. Every rule id here MUST appear in NORMATIVE-RULES.md and vice versa; a test enforces that.

checkedByLegend.schematron: schema/qusx.sch via any ISO Schematron processor
checkedByLegend.js: src/validate.js (needs canonical reference data and/or corpus)

rules.summary: Document is well-formed XML 1.0.
Document element is <qusx>.
No element carries a duplicate attribute name.
<qusx> carries all required attributes.
surah is an integer 1-114.
ayahCount is an integer 1-286.
revelationPlace is makkah or madinah.
bismillahPre is xs:boolean.
tradition is a traditionCode enumeration value.
Every child of <qusx> is an allowed element.
<word> carries id and position, both positive integers.
<word> type, if present, is 'number'.
<sajda> carries number, type (required|optional), verseKey (pattern).
fragment, if present, is whole|start|middle|end.
Filename NNN.qusx.xml encodes the same surah as the surah attribute.
name equals the canonical simple name for surah.
nameArabic equals the canonical Arabic name for surah.
revelationPlace equals the canonical revelation place for surah.
bismillahPre equals the canonical bismillah-pre flag for surah.
ayahCount equals the expected count for (surah, tradition); skipped when no verified count exists.
A milestone carries exactly one of sid or eid (XOR).
An opening pin (sid) carries its axis's required opening attributes.
Every sid value is unique within the document.
Within one axis, no pin opens while a previous same-axis pin is still open.
A closing pin (eid) matches the currently-open sid on the same axis.
Every sid is closed by a matching eid; no axis remains open at end of document.
Cross-axis overlap is explicitly permitted; axes need not nest.
fragment, if present, appears on an opening (sid) pin, not a closing (eid) pin.
fragment values are descriptive; v1 validates their shape, not cross-file reconstruction.
Opening ayah numbers are exactly 1..ayahCount, contiguous, once each, in order.
word id is strictly increasing in document order across the file.
word position counts 1..N within each ayah, resetting at each ayah opening.
Every word appears inside an open ayah range.
Every ayah pin's tradition equals the root tradition; no mixing.
Root tradition selects the conformance profile (hafs-kufi core vs experimental).
If normalization=NFC, every word text is already NFC.
normalization is a producer claim; only NFC triggers the v1 check.
A complete Hafs corpus has exactly 114 surah files.
Corpus ayah total is 6236 (Hafs).
Corpus word total is 83668 (Hafs).
Corpus sajda total is 15.
Corpus ruku total is 558.
Highest page number per layout equals that edition's known page count.
Per surah, word text+morphology is byte-identical across every layout.
QUL raw text matches Tanzil full-options at the committed baseline (6230/6236); no regression.
With the correction overlay, match reaches 6234/6236 and residuals are exactly {11:13, 80:25}.
